@greetingName.description: The greeting after the user types a name.

planPageSubtitle: Keep scoring rules, versions and release state in one place.
planEmptyHint: Built-in rules appear here after the local database is initialized.
planSelectHint: Select a plan to see its versions.
planLoadError: Could not open the local database
planConfigSubtitle: Edit the rules and save a new version. Earlier versions stay available.
planSystemCannotRetire: Built-in plans cannot be retired. Update the plan and save a new version.
batchPageSubtitle: Import a workbook, calculate results and export the report.
batchEmptyHint: Create a batch to import a workbook and calculate results.
batchNewSubtitle: Set the term and exam this batch belongs to.
batchSelectHint: Select a batch to see its details.
batchSelectVersion: Select a published plan version first.
batchCalculated: Calculated %d result rows and %d personal scores.
zeroIntro: These classes have missing or zero targets. Fill each tier, or exclude the class from completion.
overviewSubtitle: Readiness, recent exams and the next step for the current cohort.
overviewNoCohort: No cohorts yet. Create a cohort to get started.
overviewNoExams: No exams yet. Create an exam once the basics are ready.
gaokaoHint: The graduating year is this year. Open the gaokao assessment when the exam data is ready.
overviewNoData: No data summary yet. Import students and scores first.
newCohortSubtitle: Enter the enrollment year. Tally shows the current grade level and graduating class.
cohortPageSubtitle: Manage cohorts, graduating classes and stage records.
cohortSelectHint: Select a cohort to see its stages and classes.
cohortNoStages: No stage records yet. A record is added when the academic year starts.
cohortNoClasses: No classes yet. Import a student list to create classes.
settingsSubtitle: Manage the academic year, local data and interface language.
settingsAcademicYearHint: Tally follows the system date by default and starts a new academic year on September 1.
helpSubtitle: Import guide, terms and the order of preparation.
helpImportGuideHint: Each data item has its own import. Column names follow the file you receive.
helpStudentsRequirement: Columns: student ID, name, class. Classes are created from the class column.
helpAssignmentsRequirement: Columns: teacher name, subject, teaching group or class.
helpBaselineRequirement: Columns: student ID or candidate number, each subject score, total score.
helpScoresRequirement: Columns: exam number or student ID, each subject score, absence or violation marks.
helpCutoffsRequirement: Columns: subject, track, undergraduate cutoff. Total cutoffs include the tier.
helpTargetsRequirement: Columns: class, tier, target count. Merged group targets include the group name.
helpTermCohortBody: Students who enrolled in the same year, for example the 2026 cohort.
helpTermClassOfBody: Students who graduate in the same year, for example the Class of 2029.
helpTermStageBody: Grade 10, 11 or 12, derived from the cohort and the current academic year.
helpTermYearBody: September to August, for example the 2026-2027 academic year.
helpTermBaselineBody: The comparison baseline formed by enrollment scores. The current rule uses the zhongkao scores.
helpTermMergedBody: Used when walking-class teaching groups are merged for the pass rate.
studentsEmpty: No students yet. Import a student list to get started.
facultyPageSubtitle: Browse teachers and their teaching assignments.
facultyEmpty: No teachers yet. Import teaching assignments to get started.
groupsPageSubtitle: Manage teaching groups and merged groups.
groupsEmpty: No teaching groups yet. Import teaching assignments to get started.
baselinePageSubtitle: Review entry scores and class targets.
baselineEmpty: No entry scores yet. Import zhongkao scores to get started.
examsPageSubtitle: Review exam scores and cutoff scores.
examsEmpty: No scores yet. Import a score sheet to get started.
examsEmptyHint: Create an exam, then import its roster, scores, cutoffs and targets.
importsPageSubtitle: Review each import, its changes and its problems.
analysisPageSubtitle: Compare teachers, classes, subjects and assessments.
analysisEmpty: No data to compare yet. Complete an assessment to see trends.
resultsSubtitle: Review the result rows and export the workbook.
resultsEmpty: No results yet. Start a calculation in Assessments.

dataSearchGroups: Search by teaching group or subject
dataSearchBaseline: Search by class, subject or entry set
dataSearchImports: Search by file, path or sheet
dataNoCohortHint: Students, teachers and teaching groups belong to a cohort and its current stage.
dataNoStage: This cohort has no editable stage
dataNoStageHint: Choose a stage from the overview, or switch to an academic year with an active stage.
importAssignmentsDone: Imported %d teachers, %d teaching groups and %d assignments.
importNoStage: Choose a cohort and a stage before importing.
settingsSubjectsHint: Names, full marks and availability apply to new exams.
settingsTracksHint: Tracks classify students for cutoff scores.
settingsRestoreConfirm: Restore backup %s? The current database is backed up first.
importWizardSheetHint: Choose the worksheet that holds this data item. Columns are matched automatically and can be changed on the next step.
importWizardSheetMissing: This worksheet is no longer available.
importWizardAlreadyImported: This file has already been imported for this data item.
importKindClassesPurpose: Create the administrative classes for this cohort and stage.
importKindStudentsPurpose: Students are matched to scores and entry scores. Classes are created from the list.
importKindTeachersPurpose: Teacher identities connect assignments and personal scores.
importKindAssignmentsPurpose: Assignments decide which teacher teaches each class and subject.
importKindBaselinesPurpose: Entry scores are the baseline for average improvement.
importIssueDuplicateStudent: Student number %s appears more than once.
importIssueUnknownStatus: %s is not a recognized status and is treated as active.
importIssueDuplicateTeacherNo: Teacher number %s appears more than once.
importIssueTeacherNameConflict: %s teaches %s more than once with different teacher numbers.
importIssueTeacherIdentity: Teacher %s needs a teacher number or a subject.
importIssueClassCreated: Class %s does not exist yet and will be created.
importIssueUnknownClass: Class %s does not exist in this stage.
importIssueScoreOutOfRange: %s is outside the full mark of %s.
importIssueRatioNotPositive: The baseline ratio must be greater than zero.
importIssueDuplicateBaseline: %s · %s has more than one entry score.
importResultClasses: Imported %d classes. This stage now has %d classes.
importResultTeachers: Imported %d teachers. This stage now has %d teachers.
importResultAssignments: Imported %d assignments. This stage now has %d teaching groups and %d assignments.
importResultBaselines: Imported %d entry score rows. This stage now has %d rows.
importUndoNotImported: This import has already been undone.
importUndoExam: Exam data imports cannot be undone. Re-import the corrected file instead.
importUndoBlocked: A newer import exists in this stage. Undo the newer import first.
importUndoNoChanges: This import predates change tracking and cannot be undone.
stageAdvanceBody: This cohort moved to %s. Copied %d classes, %d teaching groups and %d assignments for review.
stageReviewBody: Review the copied structure before you continue. Entry scores, exams and results stay with their original records.
stageReadOnly: This is a historical stage. Its data is read-only.
prepSubtitle: Complete these items in order. Each item has its own import and source record.
prepClassesBody: Classes hold students, class targets and completion scores.
prepStudentsBody: Students are matched to scores and entry scores. Classes are created from the list.
prepTeachersBody: Teacher identities connect assignments and personal scores.
prepAssignmentsBody: Assignments decide which teacher teaches each class and subject.
prepBaselinesBody: Entry scores are the baseline for average improvement.
examNewSubtitle: Choose the term, exam type, date and cohorts. Each cohort gets its own assessment.
examDateHint: Choose the date shown in the exam record.
examPrepSubtitle: Complete the roster, scores, cutoffs and targets before calculation.
examPrepNoExamHint: Open an exam to see its preparation checklist.
examKindRosterPurpose: The roster decides who takes the exam, their class and track.
examKindScoresPurpose: Scores provide the averages, pass counts and completion data.
examKindCutoffsPurpose: Cutoffs decide the subject pass counts for this exam.
examKindTargetsPurpose: Targets provide the denominators for completion and pass rates.
examSearchRoster: Search by student number, name or exam number
examSearchScores: Search by student number or name
examRosterEmptyHint: Generate a roster from the cohort or import a roster file.
examScoresEmptyHint: Import a score sheet after the roster is ready.
examTargetsHint: Enter the target count for each class and tier. Zero targets are flagged before calculation.
examTargetsEmptyHint: Import a target sheet or enter targets by class.
examGroupsEmptyHint: Create a merged group when teaching groups are combined for a pass rate.
examStatGroupDeleteBody: The merged group and its members are removed from this assessment. Existing results stay unchanged.
examQualityEmptyHint: Roster, scores, cutoffs and targets match the current rules.
